verdict.rationale: Lorikeet claims one-step connection to your ticketing system, knowledge base and internal tools to "seamlessly ingest data". It also says it trains the agent on help docs and SOPs with no migration, so the core of no-re-authoring knowledge ingestion is claimed. The evidence is marketing-level only: it never names connectors for help centers or wikis, never confirms past tickets are used as grounding knowledge rather than just simulation replay, and gives no sync or refresh details. Missing for 10: explicit internal-wiki connectors, past tickets confirmed as a knowledge source, documented connector list and sync behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the agent ingests my help center, docs, past tickets, and internal wikis as knowledge sources without manual re-authoring

citations.quote: Connect Lorikeet in seconds to your ticketing system, knowledge base, and internal tools to seamlessly ingest data and take action for your customers
train the agent on your business context, brand guidelines, help docs and standard operating procedures
No migration required: Lorikeet works alongside your existing tools.
